verdicts.evidence: Measured on Node v24.18.0: readFileSync(package.json, "") returns a Buffer and JSON.parse coerces it identically, so VERSION is the same string "0.37.0"; JSON.stringify of both parses is byte-equal, including on a non-ASCII fixture. init wrote the same 121 files and runward/scaffold-lock.json (which embeds VERSION) is byte-identical to the pristine one; unit 812/812, smoke, oscal/intoto/spelling/sarif/audit all green.
